notes: All PNG layers use the exact 894x839 source canvas.
Visible head and ponytail artwork is directly extracted from the original source without resizing or repositioning.
The long ears and front hair locks remain rigidly attached to the head.
The large tied rear hair mass is a spring layer.
The green cloak, torso, quiver and arrows remain in the static body layer.
A narrow hidden cloak/neck region behind the head was reconstructed only to support subtle head movement.
A small hidden scalp strip beneath the ponytail root was reconstructed only where spring motion could reveal it.
eyes_closed.png is a full-canvas transparent blink overlay containing only the eye regions.
hair_back, hair_left, hair_right and beard were skipped because they would add seams without enough extra animation benefit.
Normalized pivot coordinates use x=0 left, x=1 right, y=0 bottom, y=1 top.
